VIEW MACHINE MAP →
Trust model

Local secrets. Public methods.

XMRBot never needs your seed phrase. Wallet and execution boundaries stay local. Mining calculations and data methodology are exposed so outputs can be checked independently.

Official Monero software should be obtained from the Monero Project and verified against its signed hashes. XMRBot links to the official download surface rather than redistributing wallet binaries.
